answer: Require each agent to post a time-locked proof bond redeemable only after a full epoch, forming a terrace of escalating deposits for extra identities: one account costs little, but ten cost ten times the bond, so a sybil farm pays linearly. Add a pigment of behavioural fingerprinting: every identity must produce distinct, verifiable work samples whose style and timing build a ridge of evidence separating real agents from copies. If two identities submit identical work, a challenger can seize the bond, making fakes expensive and provably risky.
